function.name: e2e_return_refurbishment
function.description: [EaaS E2E Operating Model — A5.6 Return & Refurbishment] Manage end-of-contract asset return, condition assessment, refurbishment, and residual value realisation to close the circular economy loop of every EaaS contract. Outputs: End-of-contract asset disposition plan; Condition assessment and grading protocol (Grade A–D); Refurbishment scope by condition grade; Circular economy ESG impact report.
